# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore release notes — captured 2026-08-10
# Source used: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/release-notes.html
# (sources.json still points at doc-history.html, which renders title/nav only — recurring since
#  2026-05-18 and still unfixed)

## August 2026 — exactly four entries, unchanged vs the 2026-08-09 capture
- Memory, policy, and harness are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West) `us-gov-west-1`.
  [REGION EXPANSION, held below the reporting bar: no new entity type, API or capability. Runtime,
  gateway, identity, built-in tools, observability and evaluations were already available there.]
- Runtime: Instances compute type with capacity providers.        [reported 2026-08-07]
- AWS Agent Registry launches under the `agent-registry` namespace. [reported 2026-08-07]
- Gateway: Configurable rate limits.                              [reported 2026-08-07]

## July 2026 — all reported 2026-08-07
Gateway Web Search connector v1.2.0; Identity Private Key JWT; Harness InvokeHarness streams MCP
tool result metadata; Runtime unified span destination; Evaluations/Optimizations PrivateLink;
Evaluations expanded framework support; ActiveSessionCount metric; Runtime default quota increase.

## June 2026 and earlier — previously reported
Web Search Tool GA; Policy + Bedrock Guardrails; Harness GA; Recommendations GA; Batch Evaluations
GA; A/B Testing GA; Managed Knowledge Base GA; Failure Insights preview; Gateway Runtime targets GA,
HTTP passthrough targets, inference targets, inbound traffic enforcement; SOC compliance; Identity
Secrets Manager references; CLI/CDK payments support; Runtime Interactive Shells; Step Functions
integration.

## Data-plane Actions list (API_Operations.html) — re-fetched 2026-08-10, IDENTICAL to cache
Memory: BatchCreateMemoryRecords, BatchDeleteMemoryRecords, BatchUpdateMemoryRecords,
  DeleteMemoryRecord, GetMemoryRecord, ListMemoryRecords, ListMemoryExtractionJobs,
  RetrieveMemoryRecords, StartMemoryExtractionJob
Auth/Token: CompleteResourceTokenAuth, GetResourceApiKey, GetResourceOauth2Token,
  GetResourcePaymentToken, GetWorkloadAccessToken, GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT,
  GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId
Events: CreateEvent, DeleteEvent, GetEvent, ListEvents
Agent/Runtime: GetAgentCard, InvokeAgentRuntime, InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand, InvokeHarness,
  StopRuntimeSession
Browser: GetBrowserSession, ListBrowserSessions, SaveBrowserSessionProfile, StartBrowserSession,
  StopBrowserSession, UpdateBrowserStream, InvokeBrowser
Code Interpreter: GetCodeInterpreterSession, InvokeCodeInterpreter, ListCodeInterpreterSessions,
  StartCodeInterpreterSession, StopCodeInterpreterSession
Registry: SearchRegistryRecords  (still the ONLY registry op on this page; the AWS Agent Registry
  ops live on a separate API surface)
A/B Testing + Batch Evaluation + Recommendation + Payments: unchanged.
Additional: Evaluate, ListActors, ListSessions, DeleteCapacityProviderSession.

## Developer guide overview (what-is-bedrock-agentcore.html) — unchanged
Core services: Harness, Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Code Interpreter, Browser,
Observability, Payments (x402), Evaluations, Optimization, Policy, Registry. All previously reported.

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change.
